title: Controls that join and split like drops
blurb: A <button> whose arrow pinches off, a <nav> dock that bulges round a link, and a <details> menu that pours out of its summary. The canvas blurs a copy of itself, cuts it at a threshold and draws the elements again inside the outline, so the labels stay sharp.
question: The CSS way to make shapes join like drops is a blur and a hard contrast on a wrapper, which ruins any text inside. Can a canvas do the same to native controls and keep their labels, focus rings and hit boxes?
result: Yes, in 2D. A blurred drawImage() copy of the canvas, drawn back through an SVG threshold filter, gives the joined outline, and source-atop keeps the second draw of each element inside it.
